title: HopResult
description: Clean target-speaker audio returned by the separation server for one or more hops.

seq.description: Sequence number of the newest hop covered by this result.

pcm.description: Base64-encoded 16 kHz mono little-endian int16 PCM clean target voice (typically 8000 samples for 0.5 s).

gpu_ms.description: GPU inference duration in milliseconds on the separation server.

queue_ms.description: Time in milliseconds spent waiting for the GPU lock before inference.

t_return.description: Unix milliseconds timestamp when the result was produced or received.

covers.description: Inclusive [first_seq, last_seq] range of hops covered if multiple hops were merged.

samples.description: Number of int16 PCM samples in pcm.

t_capture.description: Echoed client capture timestamp in Unix ms for end-to-end RTT measurement.

sent_ms.description: Echoed client send timestamp in Unix ms (binary fast path).

rtt_ms.description: Measured round-trip time in milliseconds on the client clock.

engine.description: Separation engine that produced this result.
